title: Write unit tests for tags.ts
description: Create comprehensive Vitest unit tests for the exit tag detection functions in tags.ts. Cover all three functions with positive and negative test cases.
acceptanceCriteria: detectComplete tests: returns true with <complete> tag, returns false without
detectComplete tests: detects tag in mid-text, not just at start/end
detectBlocked tests: extracts reason text correctly
detectBlocked tests: returns null for missing tag
detectDecide tests: returns null for missing tag
npm test passes all tags.test.ts cases

steps.details: Create the test file. Import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest'. Import the three functions from tags.ts.

describe('detectComplete', () => { it('returns true for text containing <complete>', ...) it('returns false for text without tag', ...) it('detects tag in mid-sentence', ...) it('is case-sensitive', ...) // <Complete> should NOT match })
describe('detectBlocked', () => { it('extracts single-line reason', ...) it('extracts multi-line reason', ...) it('returns null when tag absent', ...) it('handles empty reason', ...) })
describe('detectDecide', () => { it('extracts question text', ...) it('returns null when tag absent', ...) it('handles multi-line question', ...) })

steps.description: Run tests and verify all pass
steps.details: Run `npm test`. All tests should pass. Fix any failures.

technicalNotes: Vitest uses the same describe/it/expect API as Jest — test patterns are identical
